name: rank
comment: ClickHouse type: UInt32. Place on the leaderboard as the game sends it, starting at 1. Players can share a place, and the following places are then skipped (1, 2, 2, 4). Not a rank badge.

name: leaderboard_position
comment: ClickHouse type: UInt32. Index of the entry in the list the game sends, starting at 1 and unique within a snapshot.
